name: Muhammad Sanusi Md Nor
_note: M2 opposition-executive cohort: Menteri Besar of Kedah since 17 May 2020 (second term from 14 Aug 2023). Added to populate the sub-national-executive comparability class with opposition (PN) executives alongside government premiers, so the partisan-signal gate can compare like-with-like. Objective spine (A5) plus Layer B editorial evidence on file; NO coder panel yet, so Layer B is unscored and the leader is below ranking validity. Layer B carries anchor values pending an independent coder panel (methodology.validity.minCodersToScore=3). Citations verified to exist via search; article full text was not opened (environment fetch restriction), so facts rest on cross-outlet-corroborated search summaries and require primary-source reconfirmation before any independent panel finalizes the score. 3R-sensitive: the 2023 sedition matter is recorded as factual court STATUS only (acquitted), and B5 is deliberately left unscored because the underlying royalty-remark dispute is contested and ended without conviction.

metrics.justification: Charged on 18 Jul 2023 with two counts of sedition over an 11 Jul 2023 campaign speech (remarks touching the Sultan of Selangor and the Yang di-Pertuan Agong); pleaded not guilty. Acquitted and discharged of the Selangor charge on 10 Dec 2024 (prosecution withdrew after the Sultan accepted his apology) and granted a full acquittal of the Agong-related charge on 24 Feb 2025. Recorded as the subject's own court STATUS only, not a verdict on guilt; a separate civil defamation suit was filed in 2023 with no confirmed outcome.

citation.title: Kedah MB Sanusi freed of sedition charge over remarks about 16th Agong

metrics.justification: After the July 2022 Kupang/Baling flash floods killed three people, he called for the floods to be declared an emergency to speed aid (5 Jul 2022) and issued a public apology to victims (15 Jul 2022), and the state later built replacement houses; the response drew criticism for telling victims to accept their fate and for attributing the disaster mainly to a natural headwaters cause. Documented response with mixed outcomes (anchor 2).

citation.title: Declare floods in Baling as emergency, says Kedah MB

metrics.justification: Announced in January 2025 that Kedah collected more than RM700 million in revenue for 2024, framed as 102% of target and the highest in state history without federal funds; the figure is the state government's own revenue-collection claim, set against a tabled RM1.241 billion deficit budget, with projected rare-earth and carbon-credit revenue still prospective. Partial, claim-based delivery rather than an audited structural reform (anchor 2).

citation.title: MB: Kedah's 2024 revenue is highest in history

metrics.justification: In November 2023, after PN's 33-of-36-seat supermajority, his administration continued providing RM75,000 in development allocations to opposition assemblymen and recognised a Pakatan Harapan opposition leader in the assembly, a power-sharing norm several incumbent state governments withhold from opponents. Documented cross-bench allocation practice (anchor 3).

citation.title: Kedah to continue providing allocation for opposition assemblymen, says Sanusi

metrics.justification: On the royalty-remark matter he reversed an initially defiant posture with a written public apology to the Sultan of Selangor dated 25 Sep 2024 (acknowledged by the Sultan on 26 Sep 2024), which preceded the withdrawal of that charge; by contrast he publicly refused to apologise over a separate defamation demand. A documented, dated candid reversal on the record (anchor 3).

citation.title: Sanusi issues public apology to Selangor Sultan
